method.baseline: 60% 2024 presidential + 40% 2022 midterm statewide race(s), blended in log-odds; two-party Dem share
method.swing: Proportional (log-odds) swing applied equally to every county until the geography hits the target two-party share
method.turnout: Expected 2026 two-party vote = 2022 two-party vote in the same county (re-estimated live from fully counted counties)

NC-05.name: North Carolina 5th District
NC-05.lines_note: Lines unchanged since 2024. 2022 House results were on different lines and are omitted.

NC-11.name: North Carolina 11th District
NC-11.lines_note: Lines unchanged since 2024. 2022 House results were on different lines and are omitted.

OH-07.name: Ohio 7th District
OH-07.lines_note: Redrawn in 2025: adds Ashland County, drops the Holmes sliver. Ashland, Medina and Wayne are whole counties; the Cuyahoga part uses its 2024-lines part as a proxy.

TX-15.name: Texas 15th District
TX-15.lines_note: Redrawn in 2025: now runs from Hidalgo north through the Coastal Bend (Aransas, Bee, Refugio, San Patricio, Goliad, DeWitt, Gonzales, Lavaca); Guadalupe, Wilson and Karnes moved out. Whole counties use their county baselines; the Hidalgo part uses its 2024-lines part as a proxy.

TX-23.name: Texas 23rd District
TX-23.lines_note: Redrawn in 2025 (27 counties). Whole counties use their county baselines; the Bexar and El Paso parts use their 2024-lines parts, which the March 2026 primary shows are about the same size (Bexar ~22% of the county, El Paso ~8%).
